About us

A journey that shaped the industry

From a small family business to a national player. We have grown by always putting our clients' safety first.

  1. 2019

    The company is founded

    Swedbevakningstjänster AB starts with a clear vision: to raise the standard of what a local security company can deliver. The client was at the centre from day one, as a partner rather than just a customer.

  2. 2020

    Authorisation and professional growth

    We became an authorised security company with F-tax and VAT registration: a promise to deliver at the level of the big players, with the closeness of a smaller company.

  3. 2022

    Expansion and long-term partnerships

    Recurring agreements with property owners, retail chains and public bodies across Stockholm County. Physical guarding combined with strategic advice.

  4. 2024

    New markets

    Specialised consulting and investigation services were added, and we established operations in Malmö and Gothenburg.

  5. Today

    Setting the standard

    We grow steadily and take assignments nationwide. Local presence, national reach and personal commitment go hand in hand.

Questions & answers

Frequently asked questions

Is Swedbevakning an authorised security company?

Yes. We are authorised under Swedish law, hold F-tax approval and are VAT registered. We have been operating since 2019.

Which areas do you cover?

We work mainly across Stockholm County and also operate in Malmö and Gothenburg. We also take assignments anywhere in Sweden when needed.

What kind of assignments do you take?

Everything from retail security and patrols to event security, consulting and internal investigations. We work with both companies and private individuals.

How quickly can you start a new assignment?

For urgent needs we can often be on site within 24 hours. Contact us to discuss what you need.

How does pricing work?

We prepare tailored quotes based on needs, scope and risk level. Fill in the form and we'll get back to you quickly.
